_meta.indication: TIBSOVO is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) with a susceptible IDH1 mutation as detected by an FDA-approved test.

pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory AML with an IDH1 mutation
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Rate of complete remission (CR) plus complete remission with partial hematologic recovery (CRh)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions include fatigue (39%), leukocytosis (38%), arthralgia (36%), diarrhea (34%), dyspnea (33%), edema (32%) and nausea (31%); serious adverse reactions (≥5%) were differentiation syndrome (10%), leukocytosis (10%), and electrocardiogram QT prolonged (7%).
target_moa: Ivosidenib is a small molecule inhibitor that targets the mutant isocitrate dehydrogenase 1 (IDH1) enzyme; susceptible IDH1 mutations lead to increased levels of 2-hydroxyglutarate (2-HG) in leukemia cells.

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: DIFFERENTIATION SYNDROME — patients treated with TIBSOVO have experienced symptoms of differentiation syndrome, which can be fatal if not treated; if suspected, initiate corticosteroid therapy and hemodynamic monitoring until symptom resolution.

companion_dx_detail: Abbott RealTime IDH1 Assay is the FDA-approved test for selection of AML patients with a susceptible IDH1 mutation for treatment with TIBSOVO.

advisory_committee.vote: This application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants.

description.text: Added indication for newly-diagnosed AML in adults ≥75 years or with comorbidities precluding intensive induction chemotherapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for the use of Tibsovo® (ivosidenib) tablets for the treatment of adult patients with newly-diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia (AML) who are \ge 75 years old or who have comorbidities that preclude use of intensive induction chemotherapy.

description.text: Added new indication for previously treated, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma with an IDH1 mutation in adults

description.text: Added indication in combination with azacitidine or as monotherapy for newly diagnosed AML with a susceptible IDH1 mutation in adults 75+ or with comorbidities precluding intensive induction chemotherapy

citations.quote: TIBSOVO is indicated in combination with azacitidine or as monotherapy for the treatment of newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia (AML) with a susceptible isocitrate dehydrogenase-1 (IDH1) mutation as detected by an FDA-approved test in adults 75 years or older, or who have comorbidities that preclude use of intensive induction chemotherapy.
